nodes.name: sklearn.cluster.spectral_affinity_bookkeeping
nodes.description: Deterministic SpectralClustering affinity-branch bookkeeping above deferred nearest-neighbor search, pairwise-kernel callbacks, spectral embedding, and label assignment.
